asked: Before concluding Gemini cannot recycle: could an immediate, executable complement have closed the position below par after real fees?

corpus.model_a: FROZEN, not consulted; only HOW the complement is acquired changes

structural_result.claim: A maker OPEN completed immediately by a taker cannot produce a sub-par pair. It is arithmetic, not an observation.
structural_result.yes_leg: rested a YES bid at p, hit by an aggressor SELL -> surviving best bid b <= p, NO costs (1-b), gross pair = p+1-b >= 1
structural_result.no_leg: rested a NO bid at n (a YES ask at 1-n), lifted by an aggressor BUY -> surviving ask a >= 1-n, gross pair = n+a >= 1
structural_result.consequence: Every cent of sub-par basis must come from the book MOVING after the fill, in favour of the leg already held.

opportunity.time_resolution_caveat: seconds_after_open is measured from the first CYCLE at which the residual was visible, not from the fill print; the cycle interval is ~8s, so t=0 rows are up to one cycle after the fill.

decomposition_of_locked_edge.reading: The edge is the residual's DIRECTIONAL gain being crystallized. Execution contributes -0.0988 (spread + fees), never a positive.

selection_effect.note: matched-pair economics and directional-residual P&L are reported SEPARATELY and are never summed. A mark is not realized P&L.
selection_effect.reading: A 'complete when <= $1' rule is a take-profit with no stop: it banks the 14 episodes that moved our way and retains the 15 that did not. The retained residual is 27x worse per unit.

l5_comparison.question: does L5's taker use rise with residual, or with time?
l5_comparison.verdict_time: YES, monotonically: 2.8% -> 58.5%, a 21x rise into expiry. L5 is maker-dominant early and majority-TAKER inside 30s.
l5_comparison.verdict_residual: NO. complete and extend (both carry inventory) have near-identical taker rates in every TTE bucket, so inventory state does not drive it. TIME does.
l5_comparison.correction: An earlier figure of p_taker mean 0.0289 was quoted here as L5's taker rate. That is the mean pooled over states dominated by long TTE; conditioned on TTE the rate reaches 0.585. The pooled number understated late-window taker use by an order of magnitude.

cross_venue_economics.reading: L5's taker completion is behaviourally faithful AND cheap: he pays ~1c of spread. The same action on Gemini pays a median 28c. The BEHAVIOUR transfers; the ECONOMICS do not.

verdict.can_gemini_recycle: YES. Hybrid completion recycles 14 of 29 residual episodes where maker/maker recycled 5. 'Gemini cannot recycle' is false.
verdict.is_it_profitable: NOT from execution. The pair edge is the residual's directional gain minus a certain 9.9c round-trip cost, and the rule retains adversely-selected losers.
verdict.recommendation: Do NOT promote. Keep offline. Hybrid completion is a risk/turnover tool priced at ~9.9c per pair on this venue, not a source of pair edge, and residual direction is not assumed to have skill.
